methods.name: Sudden Landslide Identification Product (SLIP)
methods.summary: A pixel-based thresholding method that identifies new landslides by analyzing percentage red reflectance change, changes in mNMDI, slope derived from DEM, and a land-cover mask.
methods.verbatim: Recently, Fayne et al. (2019) developed an automatic approach for landslide identification named Sudden Landslide Identification Product (SLIP) incorporating Landsat-8 OLI imagery.
